blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Taxes can sound hard, but in English they follow simple patterns. At Czarnikow, the fiscal team makes a plan for next year. Today Sophie shows the plan to the team in easy English.

Next year, some things are going to change. The company is going to use new software for the tax forms. Sophie is going to train the team, one step at a time. She says, "Go slow. You can do it."

The plan is not big or scary. Taxes are just one more part of the company's routine. The team is going to check every form before the deadline. Then the plan stays safe in the fiscal folder.

items.q: What is Sophie going to do next year?
items.why: "Sophie is going to train the team, one step at a time."

items.q: What is going to change next year?
options: The software for the tax forms
items.why: "The company is going to use new software for the tax forms."

items.q: When does the team check every form?
items.why: "The team is going to check every form before the deadline."

items.q: The text suggests that Sophie wants the team to feel…
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "Go slow. You can do it." e usa inglês fácil — quer o time tranquilo.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with the idea that…
options: taxes are part of the company's routine
the team should check the forms

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie apresentar o plano fiscal do próximo ano. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello, team. Thank you for coming. Today I am going to show you our tax plan for next year. Please, go slow with me. You can do it.

First, the big news: next year we are going to use new software. It is easy to learn. I am going to train you, one small step at a time. We are going to start in January.

Next, our plan is simple. Every month we are going to check the tax forms. When a form is ready, the accountant is going to look at it. Then we are going to save it in the fiscal folder. We keep every form for seven years.

There is one change this month. The tax calendar has a new date. So we are going to send the first form a little early. Do not worry — I am going to help you.

Taxes are just one more part of our routine. One small step at a time, and the plan gets easier. Are you ready for next year? I think we are. Thank you.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Sophie going to show the team today?
options: The tax plan for next year
items.why: "Today I am going to show you our tax plan for next year."

items.q: When are they going to start with the new software?
items.why: "We are going to start in January."

items.q: How long does the company keep every form?
items.why: "We keep every form for seven years."

items.q: Why are they going to send the first form a little early?
options: The tax calendar has a new date
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "The tax calendar has a new date. So we are going to send the first form a little early."

items.q: How does Sophie want the team to feel about the plan?
items.why: Inferência: "Do not worry", "You can do it", "one small step at a time" — ela tranquiliza o time.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We have a good plan for next year." A plan is…
options: an idea of what to do
items.why: Plan = plano: uma ideia do que fazer.

items.q: "Next year we are going to change the software." To change means to…
items.why: Change = mudar: tornar algo diferente.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The team uses new ___ to fill the tax forms."
items.why: Software = programa de computador usado para os formulários.

items.q: "Sophie is going to train the new people." To train means to…
items.why: Train = treinar: ensinar as pessoas a trabalhar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We start in January, so the plan is for ___ year."
items.why: Next = próximo: o ano que vem.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please fill out the tax form." To fill out means to…
items.why: Fill out = preencher: escrever as respostas no formulário.

items.q: "The boss has to sign off on the plan." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "We are going to hand in the form on Friday." To hand in means to…
options: give it to the right person
items.why: Hand in = entregar: dar o formulário para quem precisa recebê-lo.

items.q: "Please check over the numbers before we send them." To check over means to…
items.why: Check over = revisar com atenção antes de enviar.

items.q: "Don't worry, we will sort out the small problem." To sort out means to…
items.why: Sort out = resolver: arrumar o problema.
